findings.observation: The cheek mole, broad nose, cupid bow, skin, and bun identify Ori, but the softly lidded adult eye geometry and age cues drift into a youthful generic large-eye doll face.
The lean-to-average torso and shoulder widths preserve the summon body without generic bulk or fat inflation.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and empty hands remain coherent and proportionate to the compact body.
Dark-brown wrapped topknot, offset gathered mass, parting, and single unruly curl closely preserve the summon silhouette.
Rust-charcoal fitted vest layers, soft shirt, broad folded collar, high-waist trousers, divided hem, closures, and flexible boots match the summon; no new accessory or tattoo appears.
The complete head-and-hair unit occupies approximately 39 percent of standing height, above the required 32 through 36 percent and shorter than the 2.75-head minimum.
Exactly one full-body subject has the entire bun, both empty hands, and both feet inside generous margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance has a clear compact silhouette at combat-icon scale without a weapon.
No weapon, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elite armor, frame, star, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect is present.
